text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Guarantee of Financial Support Your personal sponsor should be able to provide full financial support for your educational and living expenses for the entire length of study at SWUFE. Please upload a scanned copy of the passport or ID card of the sponsor as well. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Non-criminal Certificate Documents in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization; Provided by local police office; Generally only valids in 3~6 months * 3. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered as invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Guarantee Letter You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. First page of applicant’s personal passport Applicants shall submit a clear scanned copy of personal passport with validity later than March 1st, 2027. If the validity of the current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application. Applicants who cannot apply for passports before submitting their applications due to objective reasons, with the permission of SWUFE, may submit scanned copies of identity certificates or official documents containing the applicants’ “English name, gender, nationality, date of birth” and other information. * 6. Passport photo taken within 6 months * 7. Complete transcripts of your senior high education Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Senior High school degree/diploma certificate or an equivalent Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. If the applicant has not obtained the degree yet, then should provide an original official letter that states this student will obtain the degree before August 25th, 2026. This letter should be issued by the student’s current school. * 9. English proficiency test certificate 10. Other materials Other optional documents that could present applicants’ academic and comprehensive ability, for example, award certificate, published paper, etc. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
